{{Top}}
'''Cider''' was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|beverage]] type that was comprised, at least in part, of [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] drinks that were commonly grouped with [[beer]].<ref name="Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref> Types of cider included [[Circuit cider|Circuit Cider]], served at [[Doodnik's Café]] on [[Tyne's Horky]]<ref name="The Lost Prince">{{DroidsCite|The Lost Prince}}</ref> and [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="Dining at Dex's">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref> [[horstberry cider]], served at the [[Farrimmer Cafe]],<ref name="The Farrimmer Cafe">{{JournalCite|11|The Farrimmer Cafe}}</ref> and [[Jaffa cider]].<ref name="No Disintegrations West End Games">[[No Disintegrations (West End Games)|''No Disintegrations'']]</ref>
